Solana Wallet Solflare Goes on High Security Alert Amid Recent Crypto Attacks

Solflare co-founder Vidor said the Solana-based crypto wallet has entered a heightened state of security alert following a series of recent security incidents across the crypto industry. The team has restricted access to its infrastructure and code, introduced multiple layers of approval for all changes, and paused new additions. Vidor acknowledged that the measures would slow development but said the team was willing to accept the trade-off. — link
